payload.entry: uuid — the « à créer » entry (entity_to_create) the element is made of; one already « creee » is refused and no second element made
payload.refinement: string — optional, the DM's refinement, typed or dictated and transcribed: kept as the entry's refinement text and sent with the brief's excerpt; absent, the element is made from the excerpt alone
payload.audio: string — optional, base64 of the dictated refinement, read only when no refinement is typed: transcribed locally through the speech-to-text port, the transcript taken as the refinement; the audio is neither sent nor stored
